name: Anna Paulina Luna
stance: Wants the US to win the AI race against China while protecting humanity and US citizens.

statements.text: And we are not gods or God, and so I think that we are playing a dangerous game, especially moving into a future that is simply unknown right now, especially if we do not essentially develop the first AI super weapon. Essentially, that is what this is. Whoever does will essentially control the world, and I think that that is a very serious topic that needs to be discussed right now.

Would either or any of you be in favor of the U.S. Government through either the DIA, NSA, all agencies involved, Pentagon, even creating a super AI--I would maybe term it guardian AI--to actually train up, based on our principles, to defend the United States and potentially world against maybe a more nefarious actor like China, creating the same super weapon, because AI can only fight AI

Open AI’s Chat GPT in one instance gave directions and instructions on how a student could commit a mass shooting. I heard our AG speak about this at length. Irresponsible and dangerous is what has become of the AI they engineered.

Congress needs to convene a special session on AI and what the future of the U.S. looks like. There are very real impacts to society as we know it. Partisan politics aside, there are massive implications of a race towards super intelligence.
We need to win the AI race so we aren't answering to China, But we also have to protect humanity and protect our citizens.
AI is now becoming a national security threat that we can no longer ignore.
I am not an A.I. doomer, in fact I’m excited about all the ways it can help humanity.

Bernie Sanders is pushing AI legislation that he allegedly drafted with consultants from the U.K. Call me crazy, but America probably shouldn’t outsource its AI policy to a country that prosecutes its own citizens for Facebook comments.
